items.title: National research project awarded — Field-free topological superconductivity
items.body: Our group joins a newly selected consortium project on field-free topological superconductivity in MnBi₂Te₄/FeSe van der Waals heterostructures, under the Materials Global Young Connect Program. Building on our wafer-scale MOCVD platform, we aim to realize Majorana physics without external magnetic fields, in collaboration with domestic consortium teams and international synchrotron facilities.

items.title: IBS 2DQH Seminar — Prof. Surendra B. Anantharaman (IIT Madras)
items.body: We hosted Prof. Surendra B. Anantharaman (Dept. of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, IIT Madras) for an invited IBS Center for 2D Quantum Heterostructures (2DQH) seminar at SKKU. In his talk, “Strong light–matter interactions in 2D materials for optoelectronic applications,” he discussed harnessing the large exciton binding energy and strong light–matter coupling of 2D semiconductors for solar cells, low-threshold lasers, and LEDs, including gold/perovskite heterostructures for below-bandgap photon harvesting and chirality- and quantum-confinement effects for the deep-ultraviolet regime.

items.title: Welcoming our 2026 summer undergraduate interns and URP students
items.body: Eight undergraduate interns and URP (Undergraduate Research Program) students joined QS Lab for Summer 2026 — welcome aboard! Meet them on our People page.

items.title: Invited talk at 2D-TMDs 2026 (NUS); visits to A*STAR Q.InC and NTU
items.body: Prof. Seunguk Song delivered an invited talk at 2D-TMDs 2026 held at the National University of Singapore (NUS), and visited A*STAR's Quantum Innovation Centre (Q.InC) and Nanyang Technological University (NTU) to strengthen research collaborations.

items.title: Post-Silicon Core-Facility Center (PS-CFC) launched at SKKU — QS Lab participates
items.body: The Post-Silicon Core-Facility Center (PS-CFC), led by Prof. Ki Kang Kim at SKKU, has been selected under the Basic Science Research Capacity Enhancement Program of the Ministry of Education (2026.06–2032.02). Our group participates in quantum material growth and low-power device processing, contributing to an open-access materials–devices–analysis platform that bridges lab-scale exploration and national nanofab lines.

items.title: [Global Network] Expanding Frontiers in 2D Materials at MRS Spring 2026
items.body: Prof. Seunguk Song attended the 2026 MRS Spring Meeting in Hawaii, engaging with leading scientists in the 2D materials and quantum heterostructures fields. QS Lab continuously pushes the boundaries of quantum devices by staying at the forefront of global materials research.

items.title: Sooyoung Choi joins as Research Associate
items.body: Sooyoung Choi has officially joined our group as a Research Associate (effective March 19, 2026). She earned her M.S. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania, bringing expertise in next-generation quantum materials.

items.title: Prof. Song selected as Nanoscale 2026 Emerging Investigator
items.body: Prof. Seunguk Song has been selected as a Nanoscale 2026 Emerging Investigator by the Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC). Our MOCVD review is featured in the themed collection.

items.title: New undergraduate interns join QS Lab
items.body: Taeyoung Jeon, Minseok Kim, Seonwoo Youn, Juhyung Lee, Dahyeon Oh, Hyeonsu Kim, Seoyoung Lim, Sangmin Joo, Siwon Yang, and Jaeho Kang have joined QS Lab as undergraduate interns. Welcome, all!

items.title: 33rd Korean Conference on Semiconductors
items.body: All QS Lab members participated in the 33rd Korean Conference on Semiconductors (반도체학술대회). Three graduate students presented research posters and engaged in active discussions.

items.title: International Joint Workshop with NUS IFIM (Singapore)
items.body: We organized an international joint workshop with the Institute for Functional Intelligent Materials (IFIM) at the National University of Singapore, with talks, open discussions, and a lab tour.

items.title: Nature Reviews Electrical Engineering — Indium selenides review published
items.body: Our Perspective “Indium selenides for next-generation low-power computing devices” is published in Nature Reviews Electrical Engineering.

items.title: Gunmo Koo joins as undergraduate intern
items.body: Gunmo Koo has joined QS Lab as an undergraduate intern. Welcome, Gunmo!

items.title: Joint Workshop with IBS & University of Cambridge at ICAMD, Busan
items.body: Our lab, the IBS Center for 2D Quantum Heterostructures, and the University of Cambridge held a joint workshop at ICAMD in Busan — with talks by Profs. Mete Atatüre, Andrea Ferrari, and Manish Chhowalla.

items.title: Device (Cell Press) — Low-voltage ferroelectric FET paper published
items.body: Our collaborative work “Low-voltage ferroelectric field-effect transistors with ultrathin aluminum scandium nitride and 2D channels” is published in Device, 4, 100989 (2025).

items.title: Small Science — Edge-contacted nanosheet transistor paper published
items.body: Our work demonstrating wafer-scale fabrication of edge-contacted MoTe₂ nanosheet transistors via alloying-mediated phase engineering is published in Small Science.

items.title: Sangwon Yun joins as undergraduate intern
items.body: Sangwon Yun has joined QS Lab as an undergraduate intern. Welcome, Sangwon!

items.title: Joint Workshop with Active Soft Materials & Robots Lab
items.body: Our Quantum Semiconductors Lab held a joint workshop with the Active Soft Materials & Robots Lab (Mechanical Engineering, SKKU), planning a collaborative project on ionic-gel–based damage-free transfer of 2D materials.

items.title: Nanoscale review — MOCVD of 2D chalcogenides published
items.body: Our review “Metal-organic chemical vapour deposition of van der Waals 2D chalcogenides and heterostructures” is published in Nanoscale.

items.title: Seohee Park joins as undergraduate intern
items.body: Seohee Park has joined QS Lab as an undergraduate intern. Welcome, Seohee!

items.title: Advanced Functional Materials — Interfacial control in 2D heterostructures
items.body: Our collaborative study “Interfacial Control of Degradation Pathways in 2D Heterostructures” is published in Advanced Functional Materials.

items.title: Nature Communications — Reconfigurable carbon-nanotube ferroelectric FET published
items.body: Our collaborative work “Reconfigurable single-walled carbon nanotube ferroelectric field-effect transistors” is published in Nature Communications, 16, 7655 (2025).

items.title: Chaehui Lim joins as graduate student
items.body: Chaehui Lim has joined QS Lab as a graduate student. Welcome, Chaehui!

items.title: Yerin So joins as undergraduate intern
items.body: Yerin So has joined QS Lab as an undergraduate intern. Welcome, Yerin!

items.title: Dr. Nasir Ali joins as postdoctoral researcher
items.body: Dr. Nasir Ali has joined QS Lab as a postdoctoral researcher, focusing on quantum-phase metal–insulator transitions, metallic transport, and critical phenomena in 2D materials. Welcome, Nasir!

items.title: IBS Global Partner Lab with University of Cambridge (2025–2031)
items.body: As a participating group of the IBS Center for 2D Quantum Heterostructures (2DQH), our lab began collaboration with the University of Cambridge’s Cavendish Laboratory through the IBS Global Partner Lab.

items.title: IBS 2DQH 2025 Summer Workshop, Vivaldi Park
items.body: From July 15–17, 2025 we joined the IBS 2DQH Summer Workshop at Vivaldi Park, Hongcheon — sharing current research and discussing future plans across the 2DQH center.

items.title: Ceramist — Review on electrical measurement of 2D transistors published
items.body: Kyungwu Kwon published a first-author review “Methodologies for Electrical Measurement and Parameter Analysis of 2D Semiconductor Transistors” in Ceramist.

items.title: New graduate students join QS Lab
items.body: Wonchan Lee, Yunjung Cho, Inbae Song, and Kangpyo Cho have joined QS Lab as graduate students.

items.title: National research project awarded — vdW ferroelectric transistors
items.body: Awarded a national research project, “Development of Quantum Phase Transition Non-Volatile Control Technology via Large-Area van der Waals Ferroelectric Transistors,” funded by MSIT and the NRF of Korea (2025.03–2030.02).

items.title: National research infrastructure awarded — Cold-Wall MOCVD
items.body: Selected for a national research-infrastructure project to establish a Cold-Wall MOCVD system for quantum-semimetal synthesis, funded by MSIT and the Korea Basic Science Institute (2025.03–2026.02).

items.title: ACS Nano — High-performance MoS₂/AlScN FeFET paper published
items.body: Our paper “High Current and Carrier Densities in 2D MoS₂/AlScN Field-Effect Transistors via Ferroelectric Gating and Ohmic Contacts” is published in ACS Nano.

items.title: Participation in the BK21 FOUR program
items.body: QS Lab is participating in the BK21 FOUR Educational and Research Group for Fostering Innovative Talents in Integrated Renewable Energy Systems, funded by MOE and MSIT (through 2027).

items.title: QS Lab at SKKU officially started!
items.body: The Quantum Semiconductor Laboratory at Sungkyunkwan University has officially started. We are located at N Center 3F #86383, SKKU.

items.title: SKKU 2024 Start-up Fund awarded
items.body: Received funding through the 2024 Start-up Fund Support Program by Sungkyunkwan University (2024.08–2026.07).

items.title: IBS collaborative project joined
items.body: Participating in the IBS collaborative project “Correlation between Structure and Properties of Quantum Heterostructures at the Atomic Scale,” funded by MSIT (from 2024, for eight years).
